findings.location: Body, paragraph beginning “Those of us who can find tears…”
findings.source_quote: “If it is your case, I beseech you repent of your sins, bewail your condition, and fly to Christ for shelter!”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “nawasihi tubuni dhambi zenu” with “nawasihi mtubu dhambi zenu” to preserve the source’s singular address (“you”) and imperative sense; keep the surrounding HTML unchanged.
findings.translation_quote: “Ikiwa hali hiyo ni yenu, nawasihi tubuni dhambi zenu”

findings.location: Body, paragraph beginning “In the remnant portion of His message…”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “ajenda za kupinga utoaji mimba na ushoga” with “ajenda za kupinga utoaji mimba na haki za mashoga” (or another faithful Kiswahili rendering of opposition to gay people/causes); the current wording can be read as opposing homosexuality itself rather than the source’s stated political agendas.
